plugin.name: Formula
plugin.description: Formulas that compute: lines like F = C * 9 / 5 + 32; parameters are read from the formula. Call one anywhere with [[=name | C=37]].
field.text.placeholder: F = C * 9 / 5 + 32 (one line each; the last line is the result)
param.title: Parameter {name}
try.title: Try
error.tooLong: The formula is longer than {max} characters.
error.syntax: Line {line}: the expression is not complete.
error.badChar: Line {line}: “{char}” is not part of a formula.
error.tooDeep: Line {line}: too many brackets inside each other.
error.unknownFunctionLike: Line {line}: there is no “{name}”; did you mean {like}?
error.arity: Line {line}: {name} has the wrong number of values.
error.notFinite: Line {line}: the result is not a number.
